картина: Авторский ноутбук-челлендж Google Cloud (use-case, media generation) для разработчиков/креаторов: как оживить архивную картинку и сделать серию консистентных изображений на gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (Nano Banana 2 Lite), 16:9, 1K, IMAGE only, без чата — через явные рефы. Структура: вызов → setup (Agent Platform или AI Studio; preview-модели только в global) → хелперы (порядок contents: картинки, затем текст; ретраи на 429) → ассеты: архив (Imagen 3 beta, 2024) → неудачное 'извлечение' как удаление фона → лист персонажа (front/back + рюкзак + подписи) → первая сцена-диорама → последовательные сцены (долина, лес, поляна, восхождение, вершина, мост, гамак) с заметками после каждой → граф ассетов → метаданные в PNG → выводы. Собственные термины: character sheet, accessory sheet, asset graph, 'Image 1:/Image 2:' адресация рефов, imperative vs descriptive prompt. Повторяемые акценты: явная нумерация рефов; наследование неуказанного; явное снятие реквизита; композиция вместо терминов графредактора.

единицы.утверждение_en: Workflow for reusing an archive image: start from the archive image, extract a character into a brand-new reference image, then generate a series of images using only prompts and the new assets.
единицы.цитата: Extract a character to create a brand-new reference image
единицы.заметка: Три шага: архивное изображение → извлечение персонажа в новый реф → серия сцен только из промптов и новых ассетов.

единицы.утверждение_en: The Gemini API can be used via Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) with a Google Cloud project or via Google AI Studio with an API key; the Gen AI SDK provides a unified interface configurable by environment variables.
единицы.цитата: The Google Gen AI SDK provides a unified interface to these APIs, and we can use environment variables for the configuration.
единицы.заметка: Переменные: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_ENTERPRISE, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION или GOOGLE_API_KEY.

единицы.утверждение_en: On Agent Platform, preview models require location 'global'; for generally available models you can pick the closest Google model endpoint location.
единицы.цитата: For preview models, the location must be set to `global`.
единицы.заметка: 'must' — требование. Для GA-моделей — ближайшая локация из списка Google model endpoint locations.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) is the fastest and cheapest model in the Nano Banana family.
единицы.цитата: we'll select the Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) model, the fastest and cheapest in the Nano Banana family

единицы.утверждение_en: You can add the TEXT response modality to get potential textual feedback (or in iterative chat mode); the notebook uses IMAGE only.
единицы.цитата: # You can add the "TEXT" modality for potential textual feedback (or in iterative chat mode)
единицы.заметка: RESPONSE_MODALITIES = ['IMAGE'].
Комментарий в коде; в конфиге ASPECT_RATIO = '16:9', image_size='1K'.

единицы.утверждение_en: The notebook sets output_mime_type='image/png' only when the client uses Agent Platform and leaves it None otherwise.
единицы.цитата: output_mime_type="image/png" if client.vertexai else None,
единицы.заметка: Причина условия не объяснена; выводимо, что параметр рассчитан на Agent Platform (Vertex).

единицы.утверждение_en: Input images are passed before the prompt text in contents; with no sources, the prompt alone is sent.
единицы.цитата: contents = [*sources, prompt] if sources else prompt
единицы.заметка: Порядок sources соответствует нумерации 'Image 1', 'Image 2' в промптах (source_ids = [ROBOT, <сцена>]).

единицы.утверждение_en: Retry requests on 429 (e.g., a temporary project with 1 QPM quota) and on specific 400 'try again' errors, with up to 7 attempts and incremental waits starting at 10 s.
единицы.цитата: # Workshop: temporary project with 1 QPM quota
единицы.заметка: Из кода: tenacity.Retrying(stop_after_attempt(7), wait_incrementing(start=10, increment=1)); 400 с ' try again ' — первый доступ проекта к Cloud Storage (provisioning сервис-агента).

единицы.утверждение_en: Historic Imagen 3 (beta, July 2024) prompt for the archive image: a small hand-felted toy of a blue robot on a white background; at that time there was no determinism or consistency.
единицы.цитата: On a white background, a small hand-felted toy of a blue robot. The felt is soft and cuddly […]
единицы.заметка: Промпт приведён не полностью ('[…]' в источнике). Разбор: фон первым → субъект через материал и технику ('hand-felted toy') → тактильные свойства материала. Контекст ноутбука: 'there was absolutely no determinism or consistency at the time' — повторить персонажа тогда было нельзя.

единицы.утверждение_en: Background-removal style extraction prompt: convert everything but the robot to pure white pixels.
единицы.цитата: Convert everything but the robot to pure white pixels.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: операция в терминах графического редактора ('Convert ... to pure white pixels'), объект задан исключением ('everything but the robot'). Ноутбук оценивает это как простое удаление фона и предлагает другой подход (E-79-12, E-79-13, E-79-14).

единицы.утверждение_en: Instead of graphics-software terms, think in terms of image composition when prompting.
единицы.цитата: This prompt uses terms from graphics software, whereas we can now think in terms of image composition.

единицы.утверждение_en: Traditional binary masks are not necessarily a good idea, because object edges and shadows convey significant details about shapes, textures, positions and lighting.
единицы.цитата: It's also not necessarily a good idea to use traditional binary masks, as object edges and shadows convey significant details about shapes, textures, positions, and lighting.
единицы.заметка: Относится к подготовке рефов: вырезание на чистый фон теряет информацию краёв и теней.

единицы.утверждение_en: Perform an advanced extraction by directly generating a character sheet from the archive image instead of cutting out the subject.
единицы.цитата: perform an advanced extraction instead and directly generate a character sheet
единицы.заметка: Лист персонажа становится новым эталоном для всех следующих генераций.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini has spatial understanding, so it can provide different views of a subject while preserving its visual features.
единицы.цитата: Gemini has spatial understanding, so it can provide different views while preserving visual features.
единицы.заметка: Используется для листа 'вид спереди / вид сзади'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Structured character-sheet prompt: scene, setting, left side front view with a new backpack, right side back view, and text captions/labels.
единицы.цитата:
- Scene: Character sheet of the robot, based on the provided image.
- Setting: Isolated on a pure white background, razor-sharp focus, vibrant saturated colors, bright studio lighting.
- Left Side: Straight-on front view of the robot wearing a small backpack made of warm chocolate-brown suede, with thin, matching straps around the shoulders.
- Right Side: Straight-on back view of the robot wearing the same backpack. The backpack's flap is secured by a tiny, matte-brass, rounded-square ring buckle. The back of the robot's head must be completely seamless.
- Text: Small sans-serif text. Centered at the top, a caption "ROBOT CHARACTER SHEET". At the bottom, label the left side "FRONT VIEW" and the right side "BACK VIEW".
единицы.заметка: Разбор: маркированный список с метками секций. Scene — тип изображения + привязка к рефу ('based on the provided image'); Setting — фон, фокус, цвет, свет; Left Side/Right Side — раскладка по сторонам кадра, ракурс ('Straight-on front/back view'), новый аксессуар с материалом и цветом ('warm chocolate-brown suede'), деталь застёжки; ограничение 'must be completely seamless' для невидимой в рефе стороны; Text — шрифт, позиция, точные надписи в двойных кавычках капсом. 16:9, 1K.

единицы.утверждение_en: Focus the prompt on the composition of the scene, a common practice in media studios.
единицы.цитата: Our prompt focuses on the composition of the scene, a common practice in media studios.

единицы.утверждение_en: Repeated generations stay consistent for all features visible in the provided image, but elements described only partially (left open to interpretation) vary between generations.
единицы.цитата: Repeated generations will be consistent, preserving all robot features visible in the provided image. However, since we only described a few features of the backpack (e.g., a single buckle) and left the rest open to interpretation, we'll get slightly different backpacks.
единицы.заметка: Что есть в рефе — стабильно; новое и недоописанное — варьирует.

единицы.утверждение_en: In a production pipeline, put accessories in a separate accessory sheet rather than in the character sheet.
единицы.цитата: For simplicity, we directly included the backpack in the character sheet. In a real production pipeline, we would likely make it part of a separate accessory sheet.

единицы.утверждение_en: To control an accessory's exact shape and design, use a reference photo of the real object and instruct the model to transform it into the target style (e.g., 'transform the backpack into a stylized felt version').
единицы.цитата: To control the backpack's exact shape and design, we could also use a reference photo of a real backpack and instruct Gemini to "transform the backpack into a stylized felt version."
единицы.заметка: 'could' — возможность.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana 2 Lite generates 1K images (1024 × 1024 at 1:1) or token-wise equivalent resolutions for the other supported aspect ratios.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana 2 Lite can generate `1K` images (`1024 × 1024` pixels at the `1:1` aspect ratio) or equivalent resolutions (token-wise) for other supported aspect ratios
единицы.заметка: Размер для других соотношений — 'эквивалентный по токенам'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Larger Nano Banana models can generate 2K or 4K images.
единицы.цитата: Larger Nano Banana models can generate `2K` or `4K` images.
модели: larger Nano Banana models (так во фразе)
единицы.заметка: Какие именно модели — не названо.

единицы.утверждение_en: With aspect_ratio='16:9', Nano Banana 2 Lite generates images of 1376 × 768 pixels.
единицы.цитата: In the request configuration, we specified `aspect_ratio="16:9"`, which generates images at `1376 × 768` pixels.

единицы.утверждение_en: If aspect_ratio is omitted, Gemini uses the aspect ratio of the input image (the last one if several are provided) to select the closest supported aspect ratio.
единицы.цитата: If this parameter is omitted, Gemini uses the aspect ratio of the input image (the last one if multiple are provided) to select the closest supported aspect ratio.
единицы.заметка: Важно: берётся ПОСЛЕДНЕЕ входное изображение.

единицы.утверждение_en: First-scene structured prompt: Image 1 role, scene as macro photography of a felt diorama, background, foreground with character placement and view, lighting.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Scene: Macro photography of a beautifully crafted miniature diorama.
- Background: Soft focus on an infinite panoramic range of interspersed, dome-like smooth-felt mountains, in random shades of medium blue/green, all with curvy white snowcaps, extending over the entire horizon.
- Foreground: On the bottom left, the robot stands on the edge of a medium-gray felt cliff, captured from a 3/4 rear view, looking out over a sea of clouds (made of white cotton).
- Lighting: Studio, warm, clean and soft.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: 1) роль входного изображения ('Image 1: Reference robot character sheet'); 2) Scene — жанр съёмки + мир ('Macro photography of a beautifully crafted miniature diorama'); 3) Background — фокус, форма ('dome-like'), материал ('smooth-felt'), цвета, протяжённость; 4) Foreground — позиция в кадре ('On the bottom left'), действие, ракурс ('3/4 rear view'), материал облаков ('white cotton'); 5) Lighting — тип и характер. Материал назван у каждого элемента.

единицы.утверждение_en: Specify shapes in early scenes that later actions will need (mountains specified 'dome-like' so the character can later stand on a summit).
единицы.цитата: The mountain shape is specified as "dome-like", so our character can stand on one of the summits later on.
единицы.заметка: Планирование серии наперёд.

единицы.утверждение_en: Spend time on the first scene because it has a cascading effect on the overall look of the story; refine the prompt or run it a few times to get the preferred variation.
единицы.цитата: It's important to spend some time on this first scene, as it will have a cascading effect that defines the overall look of our story. Don't hesitate to refine the prompt or run it a couple of times to get your preferred variation.

единицы.утверждение_en: For each subsequent scene, provide the character sheet for consistency plus a previous scene for context.
единицы.цитата: From now on, our generation inputs will typically include the character sheet for consistency, along with a previous scene to provide context for the next step
единицы.заметка: Два рефа на вызов: эталон персонажа + сцена-контекст. Мультиход без чата — через явные рефы.

единицы.утверждение_en: Successive-scene prompt (valley): roles of Image 1 and Image 2, then new placement, view, prop, surroundings, background and a changed lighting.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot has descended from the cliff into a gray felt valley. It stands in the center, seen directly from the back. It is holding/reading a felt map.
- Large, smooth, round felt rocks in various beige/gray shades are visible on the sides.
- Background: The distant infinite panoramic mountain range extending over the entire horizon. A thin layer of clouds obscures its base and the end of the valley.
- Lighting: Golden hour light, soft and diffused.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: 'Image 1'/'Image 2' с ролями → переход сюжета ('has descended from the cliff into...') → позиция и ракурс ('in the center, seen directly from the back') → новый реквизит с материалом ('felt map') → окружение → фон → новый свет ('Golden hour'). Долина описана неточно — ноутбук отмечает вариативность (E-79-32).

единицы.утверждение_en: Explicitly reference the input images in the prompt ('Image 1: …', 'Image 2: …'); without them 'the robot' could refer to any of the robots in the inputs, with them the model knows it is the same robot.
единицы.цитата: The specific references to our input images (`"Image 1:…"` and `"Image 2:…"`) are important. Without them, "the robot" could refer to any of the three robots in the input images (two in the character sheet, one in the previous scene). With them, we indicate that it is the same robot.
единицы.заметка: Страница называет это 'important'. Нумерация соответствует порядку входных изображений.

единицы.утверждение_en: To prevent confusion (or if the model gets confused), be more specific with 'the [entity] from image [number]'.
единицы.цитата: To prevent confusion (or if the model gets confused), we can be more specific with `"the [entity] from image [number]"`.
единицы.заметка: Шаблон адресации: 'the [entity] from image [number]'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Without a precise description (e.g., of the valley), repeated requests produce different creative results; pick a favorite or make the prompt more precise for greater determinism.
единицы.цитата: On the other hand, since we didn't provide a precise description of the valley, repeated requests will produce different, interesting, and creative results (we can pick our favorite or make the prompt more precise for greater determinism).
единицы.заметка: Точность описания = рычаг детерминизма.

единицы.утверждение_en: Changing the lighting significantly changes the whole scene.
единицы.цитата: Here, we also tested different lighting, which significantly changes the whole scene.

единицы.утверждение_en: Successive-scene prompt (forest): story progression, material of new elements, character position/view/pose, explicit removal of the map, and continuity of rocks with Image 2.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot continues its journey through the valley and faces a dense wall of giant, thin trees hiding the entire background.
- The trees are made of light/medium/dark green felt.
- The robot is on the right, seen from a 3/4 rear angle, looking up at the trees. It is no longer holding the map. Instead, its arms are raised beside its ears.
- In the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, rocks (similar to Image 2) are partially visible.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: действие сюжета → материал новых деревьев → позиция + ракурс + взгляд → явное снятие реквизита ('no longer holding the map') + новая поза рук → преемственность через ссылку на рефы ('similar to Image 2') с позицией в углах кадра. Свет не указан — наследуется (E-79-37).

единицы.утверждение_en: You can position the character, change its point of view, and even 'animate' its arms for more expressiveness.
единицы.цитата: We can position the character, change its point of view, and even "animate" its arms for more expressiveness.

единицы.утверждение_en: State explicitly when a prop from the previous scene is gone ('no longer holding the map') so the model does not carry it over in an awkward or unwanted way.
единицы.цитата: The "no longer holding the map" instruction prevents the model from carrying it over from the previous scene in an awkward or unwanted way (like having the robot drop the map on the ground).

единицы.утверждение_en: When lighting details are not provided, the light source, quality and direction are preserved from the previous scene.
единицы.цитата: Since we didn't provide lighting details, the light source, quality, and direction are preserved from the previous scene.
единицы.заметка: Неуказанное наследуется из сцены-рефа.

единицы.утверждение_en: Successive-scene prompt (clearing): movement through the scene, new view, new ground material and explicit disappearance of rocks.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot walks through the dense forest and emerges into a clearing, making its way between two trees.
- The robot is in the center, now seen from the front.
- The ground is made of green felt, with flat patches of white felt snow. Rocks are no longer visible.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: действие-переход → позиция + новый ракурс ('now seen from the front') → смена грунта с материалом → явное исчезновение прежнего элемента ('Rocks are no longer visible'). Лес и вид не описаны — модель в целом сохраняет деревья (E-79-39).

единицы.утверждение_en: When only some elements are changed (e.g., the ground) and no further details are given for the view or other elements, the model will generally preserve most of them (e.g., the trees).
единицы.цитата: We changed the ground but didn't provide additional details for the view or the forest: the model will generally preserve most of the trees.
единицы.заметка: 'generally', 'most' — не гарантия.

единицы.утверждение_en: To return to an earlier environment, use the original scene of that environment as the reference instead of the latest scene.
единицы.цитата: Now that the valley-forest sequence is over, we can journey up to the mountains, using the original mountain scene as our reference to return to that environment:
единицы.заметка: В коде source_ids = [ROBOT, MOUNTAINS], хотя в промпте Image 2 всё ещё подписан 'Previous scene'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Structured scene prompt (ascension) with labeled Scene, Composition, Action & Details and Background sections.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- Scene: A medium-wide shot of the robot climbing a broad, dome-shaped, medium-green mountain.
- Composition: The mountain is centered, with the robot on the left slope shown from a 3/4 rear angle.
- Action & Details: The robot has both feet on the mountain and uses two miniature ice picks (felt, with brown handles and gray heads) to reach the summit, planting them into the bottom part of the white felt snowcap.
- Background: The distant mountain range spans the entire horizon.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: Scene — план ('medium-wide shot') + действие + объект с формой ('dome-shaped', согласовано с E-79-26) и цветом; Composition — расположение в кадре + ракурс; Action & Details — поза, новый реквизит с материалом и цветами частей, точка контакта; Background — фон. Image 2 здесь — исходная горная сцена, не предыдущая.

единицы.утверждение_en: The model can infer a close-up of an element that appeared only as a blurred background in the reference scene.
единицы.цитата: The mountain close-up, inferred from the blurred background, is pretty impressive.
единицы.заметка: Наблюдение по одному прогону.

единицы.утверждение_en: Successive-scene prompt (summit): reaching the top, new view, props planted in the snow, victory pose, and an explicit 'unchanged' constraint for face and hands.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot reaches the top and stands on the summit, seen from the front.
- It is no longer holding the ice picks, which are planted upright in the snow on either side.
- It has both arms raised as a sign of victory. Its face and hands are unchanged.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: действие + ракурс → судьба реквизита решена явно (не в руках, воткнуты по обе стороны) → поза с назначением ('as a sign of victory') → явное сохранение ('Its face and hands are unchanged').

единицы.утверждение_en: Imperative recomposition prompt (bridge): remove props, move and add mountains, suspend a felt bridge, place the character with a gesture, maintain background, set close-up view.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- Remove the ice picks.
- Move the center mountain to the left edge of the image and add a slightly taller medium-blue mountain to the right edge.
- Suspend a stylized felt bridge between the two mountains: its deck is made of stylized thick planks of plain felt in various wood shades.
- Place the robot in the center of the bridge with one arm pointing toward the blue mountain.
- Maintain the background.
- View: Close-up.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: каждый пункт — глагол-действие: Remove → Move/add (с позициями 'left edge', 'right edge' и относительным размером 'slightly taller') → Suspend (с материалом) → Place (позиция + жест) → Maintain (что сохранить) → View. Композиция задана действиями, а не описанием.

единицы.утверждение_en: An imperative prompt can compose the scene in terms of actions, which is sometimes easier than writing descriptions.
единицы.цитата: This imperative prompt composes the scene in terms of actions. It's sometimes easier than writing descriptions.

единицы.утверждение_en: An element added as instructed (a new mountain) came out both different and consistent with the scene.
единицы.цитата: A new mountain is added as instructed, and it is both different and consistent.
единицы.заметка: Наблюдение по одному прогону.

единицы.утверждение_en: The inserted bridge attached to the summits plausibly and seemed to obey the laws of physics.
единицы.цитата: The bridge attaches to the summits in a very plausible way and seems to obey the laws of physics.
единицы.заметка: Наблюдение по одному прогону ('seems').

единицы.утверждение_en: Explicitly resolve the fate of existing props (e.g., 'Remove the ice picks'); otherwise the model must decide what to do with them, leading to random results.
единицы.цитата: The "Remove the ice picks" instruction is there for a reason. Without it, the model would need to decide what to do with them (leave them planted, have the robot carry them, or something else entirely), leading to random results.

единицы.утверждение_en: Getting a character to consistently face a given direction in a never-generated view (e.g., walking left to right seen from the side) is tricky.
единицы.цитата: It's also possible to get the robot to walk on the bridge, seen from the side (which we haven't generated before), but getting it to consistently walk from left to right is tricky.

единицы.утверждение_en: Add left and right views to the character sheet to fix inconsistent side views.
единицы.цитата: Adding left and right views to the character sheet should fix this.
единицы.заметка: 'should fix' — ожидание, не проверено на странице.

единицы.утверждение_en: Descriptive final-scene prompt (hammock): character state and a replacement object described, with an explicit eye state.
единицы.цитата:
- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.
- Image 2: Previous scene.
- The robot is sleeping peacefully in a comfortable brown-and-tan tartan hammock that has replaced the bridge.
- Both of the robot's eyes are closed, in a "sleeping" state.
единицы.заметка: Разбор: описательная (не императивная) форма: состояние персонажа + новый объект с материалом/узором ('tartan') + явная замена ('that has replaced the bridge') → отдельный пункт на деталь, отличную от эталона ('Both of the robot's eyes are closed').

единицы.утверждение_en: Descriptive prompts work just as well as imperative ones for scene changes.
единицы.цитата: This time, the prompt is descriptive, and it works just as well as the previous imperative one.

единицы.утверждение_en: Replacing an object (bridge → hammock) preserved its attachment points on the mountain summits.
единицы.цитата: The bridge-hammock transformation is really nice and preserves the attachments on the mountain summits.
единицы.заметка: Наблюдение по одному прогону.

единицы.утверждение_en: The model rendered the character consistently in a pose and state (closed eyes) never seen before in the references.
единицы.цитата: The robot's transformation is also impressive, as it hasn't been seen in this position before, nor with closed eyes.
единицы.заметка: Наблюдение по одному прогону.

единицы.утверждение_en: Treat generated assets as a directed graph connected by 'generated from' links.
единицы.цитата: Our new assets are all related, connected by one or more "generated from" links. In terms of data structures, this is a directed graph.
единицы.заметка: В коде: у каждого ассета id, source_ids, prompt, image; граф строится по source_ids.

единицы.утверждение_en: Make assets self-sufficient by saving the prompt and source asset IDs (ancestors) in the image metadata (e.g., PNG chunks).
единицы.цитата: Our assets can be made self-sufficient by saving prompts and source asset IDs (ancestors) in the image metadata (e.g., in PNG chunks), allowing for full local storage and retrieval (without needing a database or worrying about lost prompts!).
единицы.заметка: В коде: PngInfo().add_text('source_ids', ...), add_text('prompt', ...).

единицы.утверждение_en: The model's spatial understanding enables 3D manipulation.
единицы.цитата: The model's spatial understanding enables 3D manipulation.
единицы.заметка: Итог ноутбука (повороты персонажа, новые ракурсы).

единицы.утверждение_en: You can add text to outputs (e.g., a character sheet) and also refer to text in inputs (e.g., front/back view labels).
единицы.цитата: We can add text to our outputs (character sheet) and also refer to text in our inputs (front/back views).
единицы.заметка: Явного промпта, ссылающегося на надписи FRONT VIEW/BACK VIEW, в ноутбуке нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: Consistency can be preserved across various levels: character, scene, texture, lighting, camera angle/type.
единицы.цитата: Consistency can be preserved across various levels: character, scene, texture, lighting, camera angle/type

единицы.утверждение_en: The process is a generation pipeline that can be automated (changing a node regenerates its descendants) or used to generate variations in parallel (different aesthetics, audiences, simulations).
единицы.цитата: The process we followed is essentially a generation pipeline. It can be adapted for automation (e.g., changing a node regenerates its descendants) or for generating multiple variations in parallel (e.g., the same set of images could be generated for different aesthetics, audiences, or simulations).

единицы.утверждение_en: In production, prompts could have a fixed structure with a standardized set of parameters (the notebook's prompts are intentionally simple).
единицы.цитата: For the sake of clarity and exploration, the prompts are intentionally simple. In a production environment, they could have a fixed structure with a standardized set of parameters.

единицы.утверждение_en: Scenes were described as if shot in a photo studio; virtually any other artistic style is possible (photorealistic, abstract, 2D).
единицы.цитата: We described the scenes as if they were shot in a photo studio. Virtually any other imaginable artistic style is possible

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Scene-prompt template used throughout: a bulleted list that first declares each input image's role ('- Image 1: Reference robot character sheet.', '- Image 2: Previous scene.'), then labeled sections as needed — Scene (shot type/genre), Setting/Background, Foreground/Composition (placement in frame + viewing angle), Action & Details, Lighting, View, Text.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Character sheet + First scene + Successive scenes
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Секции не обязательны: часть сцен пишется свободными пунктами после Image 1/2.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Delta prompting for sequences: each successive prompt states only what changes (placement, view, pose, added/removed props, new materials) and relies on the references for everything unspecified, which is inherited (lighting, trees, background); anything that should disappear or change must be stated explicitly.

Specificity is the page's lever of determinism: what is visible in references or described precisely stays stable; what is under-described (backpack details, valley, prop fate, unseen side views) varies between runs.

Every scene prompt carries a camera-view term (Straight-on front/back view, 3/4 rear view, seen directly from the back, seen from the front, medium-wide shot, View: Close-up) and an in-frame position (bottom left, center, on the right, left slope, left/right edge).

The miniature felt-diorama style is kept consistent by naming a material for every new element (felt, smooth-felt, white cotton, suede, matte-brass, felt ice picks, felt planks, tartan) rather than restating the style.

противоречия_внутри: В сцене восхождения (E-79-41) Image 2 подписан 'Previous scene', но по тексту и коду это исходная горная сцена MOUNTAINS (E-79-40), а не предыдущая CLEARING — метка описывает роль неточно.

Вывод 'refer to text in our inputs (front/back views)' (E-79-58) не подкреплён ни одним промптом ноутбука: сцены ссылаются на лист персонажа целиком ('Image 1: Reference robot character sheet'), а не на надписи FRONT VIEW/BACK VIEW.
не_сказано: Не сказано, сколько рефов можно/оптимально подавать (в примерах 1-2).
Не сказано явно, что 'Image N' соответствует порядку входных изображений — это видно только из кода (sources перед текстом в порядке source_ids).
Нет thinking-настроек, seed, temperature — детерминизм управляется только точностью описания.
Нет пиксельных размеров для соотношений кроме 1:1 (1024×1024) и 16:9 (1376×768).
Нет правил текста в кадре кроме примера листа персонажа.
сомнения: В метаданных партии модель страницы указана как 'Nano Banana (по контексту — gemini-2.5-flash-image)', но в тексте ноутбука явно gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (Nano Banana 2 Lite) — единицы привязаны к тексту.
Автор (Laurent Picard) без указания принадлежности; официальность — по копирайту Google LLC и репозиторию GoogleCloudPlatform.
Ряд единиц — наблюдения по одному прогону (E-79-42, E-79-46, E-79-47, E-79-53, E-79-54); помечены в заметках.
Промпт архивного изображения (E-79-10) в источнике обрезан ('[…]') и относится к Imagen 3, а не к Nano Banana.
